title: 공과금 정리하기: 룸메이트와 이번 달 고지서 보기
objective: Talk about utility bills and use -는 김에 to offer to do one more task.
summary: Two housemates go through this month's utility bills and decide how to pay.
setting: Evening, in the living room of a shared apartment. Housemates Minji and Daniel sit at the table with this month's bills.

task.title: Use the bill expressions
task.line: Use the words and the -는 김에 pattern from page 1 to choose, mark, complete, or write each answer.

words.exampleMeaning: On payday, I pay the utility bills first.

words.meaning: bill (the notice that tells you how much to pay)
words.exampleMeaning: I lost the bill, so I checked it in the app.
I forgot and paid late, so I even had to pay a late fee.

words.meaning: automatic payment from a bank account
words.example: 자동 이체를 해 두면 잊어버릴 일이 없어요.
words.exampleMeaning: If you set up automatic payment, you'll never forget to pay.

words.meaning: to split a cost and pay separately
words.example: 룸메이트와 인터넷 요금을 반씩 나눠 내요.
words.exampleMeaning: My roommate and I split the internet bill in half.

words.meaning: while (already) doing A, also do B. After a finished action, use -(으)ㄴ 김에 (켠 김에).
words.example: 우체국에 가는 김에 이 편지도 부쳐 줄래요?
words.exampleMeaning: Since you're going to the post office anyway, could you mail this letter too?

dialogue.korean: 다니엘 씨, 이번 달 고지서가 다 왔어요. 정리하는 김에 같이 볼래요?
dialogue.meaning: Daniel, all of this month's bills have arrived. Since I'm sorting them anyway, want to look at them together?

dialogue.korean: 이 고지서들은 이번 달 25일까지 내야 해요. 사흘밖에 안 남았어요. 늦게 내면 연체료가 붙어요.
dialogue.meaning: These bills have to be paid by the 25th of this month. There are only three days left. If we pay late, a late fee gets added.

dialogue.korean: 그럼 지금 은행 앱을 켠 김에 바로 낼게요.
dialogue.meaning: Then since I already have my bank app open, I'll pay it right now.

dialogue.korean: 고마워요. 그런데 매달 이렇게 하기 번거로운데, 자동 이체를 신청하는 게 어때요?
dialogue.meaning: Thanks. But doing this every month is a hassle. How about setting up automatic payment?

dialogue.korean: 좋은 생각이에요. 내일 은행에 가는 김에 물어볼게요.
dialogue.meaning: Good idea. I'm going to the bank tomorrow anyway, so I'll ask while I'm there.

dialogue.korean: 그리고 공과금은 전부 더해서 반씩 나눠 내요. 금액은 제가 계산해서 문자로 보낼게요.
dialogue.meaning: And let's add up all the utility bills and split them in half. I'll work out the amount and text it to you.

exercises: Choose the right word: ① 늦게 내서 (연체료 / 관리비)가 붙었어요. ② 깜빡하지 않게 (자동 이체 / 고지서)를 신청했어요.
Complete with -는 김에, using the verb in brackets: ① 고지서를 ____ 김에 오래된 영수증도 버렸어요. (정리하다)
Put the words in order to make a sentence: 김에 / 은행에 / 통장도 / 들른 / 새로 만들었어요
Answer in Korean: Your housemate says "저 지금 편의점 가요." Ask them to buy garbage bags (쓰레기봉투) too, using -는 김에.
answers: 은행에 들른 김에 통장도 새로 만들었어요.
편의점에 가는 김에 쓰레기봉투도 사 줄래요?
